limitations: Only document topology, links, provenance and explicitly given examples verified. Semantic review remains partial. Candidate walkthrough lacks complete strategy reference. Mechanism models do not supply real response policies. Trial packet has not been administered. Original-course directory metadata is not video content. State guards, complete poker engine, actual UI, learner outcomes and NL50 ability are not verified. Turn-card coverage is physical-only; the source-conditioned teaching contract has no acquired complete strategy and no learner results. Defense-tree results are fixed-policy best responses within explicit finite action restrictions, not a Nash solution or an acquired full defense reference. First-hand structure packet is not a precise strategy lesson or administered learner study. Suit consistency is physical/textual analysis only; the original chart was not visually confirmed. Prescription cases grade explicitly adopted course simplifications; their deterministic answers do not certify raw GTO frequencies or NL50 performance. J95 pure-action content is a conservative weak-top-pair subset; other made hands, direct combination draws and incomplete diamond metadata were not assigned invented pure actions. Mixed source retrieval is public practice content, not a frozen transfer trial.
